mapper.select: SELECT d.*, w.name AS windowName, c.name AS categoryName FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_window w ON w.id = d.window_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = d.category_id WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (window_id, category_id, name, price, stock, image, status, sales) VALUES (#{windowId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET stock = stock + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dish SET sales = sales + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dish ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
